---
title: "YBFMP Conditions Dashboard"
output:
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: columns
    vertical_layout: fill
---
  
```{r setup, include=FALSE}

library(flexdashboard)
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(leaflet)
library(DT)
library(htmltools)
library(plotly)

options(scipen = 999)


# CACHE SETTINGS


cache_file <- "ybfmp_dashboard_cache.Rdata"

use_cache <- T

cache_age_hours <- 1

# STATIONS

hydro_stations <- c(
  "FRE",
  "FWB",
  "RCS",
  "KNL",
  "CCY",
  "PTC",
  "LIS",
  "I80",
  "YBT",
  "LIS"
)

flow_stations <- c(
  "FRE",
  "RCS",
  "KNL",
  "CCY",
  "PTC",
  "YBY"
)

wq_stations <- c(
  "YBT",
  "I80",
  "LIS"
)

# SENSOR NUMBERS

S_STAGE <- 1
S_FLOW  <- 20
S_TEMP  <- 25
S_CHL   <- 28
S_DO    <- 61
S_COND  <- 100
S_FDOM  <- 266
S_FCST  <- 169

hydro_sensors <- c(
  S_STAGE,
  S_FLOW,
  S_FCST
)

# THRESHOLDS

FRE_OVERTOP <- 32

BIG_NOTCH_OPEN <- 15
BIG_NOTCH_FLOW <- 18

LEBLS_THRESHOLD <- 9

# CDEC DOWNLOAD FUNCTION ----

get_cdec <- function(
    station,
    sensor,
    start_date = Sys.Date() - 30,
    end_date = Sys.Date(),
    dur_codes = c("H","E","D")
){
  
  if(sensor %in% hydro_sensors){
    dur_codes <- c("H","E","D")
  } else {
    dur_codes <- c("E","H","D")
  }
  
  for(dur in dur_codes){
    
    url <- paste0(
      "https://cdec.water.ca.gov/dynamicapp/req/CSVDataServlet?",
      "Stations=", station,
      "&SensorNums=", sensor,
      "&dur_code=", dur,
      "&Start=", start_date,
      "&End=", end_date
    )
    
    out <- tryCatch(
      read.csv(url, stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    
    if(!is.null(out) && nrow(out) > 0){
      
      names(out) <- make.names(names(out))
      
      time_col <- names(out)[grepl("DATE", names(out), ignore.case = TRUE)][1]
      
      value_col <- names(out)[grepl("VALUE", names(out), ignore.case = TRUE)][1]
      
      return(
        tibble(station = station,
          sensor = sensor,
          duration = dur,
          datetime = as.POSIXct(out[[time_col]],
            format = "%Y%m%d %H%M", tz = "America/Los_Angeles"),
          value = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(out[[value_col]])),
          status = "OK")
      )
    }
  }
  
  tibble(station = station,
         sensor = sensor,
         duration = NA_character_,
         datetime = as.POSIXct(NA, origin = "1970-01-01", tz = "America/Los_Angeles"),
         value = NA_real_, status = "FAILED")
  
}


# DOWNLOAD DATA OR LOAD CACHE ----


if(
  use_cache &&
  file.exists(cache_file) &&
  difftime(Sys.time(), file.info(cache_file)$mtime, units = "hours") < cache_age_hours
){
  load(cache_file)
  
} else {
  
  stage_dat <- purrr::map_df(
    hydro_stations,
    ~get_cdec(
      station = .x,
      sensor = S_STAGE,
      start_date = Sys.Date()-30,
      end_date = Sys.Date()
    )
  )
  
  flow_dat <- purrr::map_df(
    flow_stations,
    ~get_cdec(
      station = .x,
      sensor = S_FLOW,
      start_date = Sys.Date()-30,
      end_date = Sys.Date()
    )
  )
  
  fcst_dat <- purrr::map_df(
    hydro_stations,
    ~get_cdec(
      station = .x,
      sensor = S_FCST,
      start_date = Sys.Date(),
      end_date = Sys.Date()+10
    )
  )
  
  do_dat <- purrr::map_df(
    wq_stations,
    ~get_cdec(
      station = .x,
      sensor = S_DO
    )
  )
  
  temp_dat <- purrr::map_df(
    wq_stations,
    ~get_cdec(
      station = .x,
      sensor = S_TEMP
    )
  )
  
  
cond_dat <- purrr::map_df(
  wq_stations,
  ~get_cdec(
    station = .x,
    sensor = S_COND
  )
)

fdom_dat <- purrr::map_df(
  wq_stations,
  ~get_cdec(
    station = .x,
    sensor = S_FDOM
  )
)

  
  save(stage_dat, flow_dat, fcst_dat, do_dat, temp_dat, cond_dat, fdom_dat, file = cache_file)
  
}


# LATEST CONDITIONS


latest_stage <- stage_dat %>%
  filter(!is.na(value)) %>%
  group_by(station) %>%
  slice_max(datetime, n = 1) %>%
  ungroup()


# ALERTS


i80_stage <- latest_stage %>%
  filter(station == "I80") %>%
  pull(value)

lebls_alert <- case_when(
  length(i80_stage)==0 ~ "NO DATA",
  is.na(i80_stage) ~ "NO DATA",
  i80_stage >= 9 ~ "LEBLS INUNDATED",
  TRUE ~ "LEBLS DRY"
)

fwb_stage <- latest_stage %>%
  filter(station == "FWB") %>%
  pull(value)

big_notch_alert <- case_when(
  length(fwb_stage)==0 ~ "NO DATA",
  is.na(fwb_stage) ~ "NO DATA",
  fwb_stage < 15 ~ "NOT FLOWING",
  fwb_stage < 18 ~ "FLOW PATH AVAILABLE",
  TRUE ~ "FLOWING THROUGH BIG NOTCH"
)


# MAP COORDINATES


stations <- tribble(~station, ~label, ~lat, ~lon,
  "FRE","Fremont Weir", 38.759250, -121.667293,
  "FWB","Big Notch", 38.764906, -121.636439,
  "RCS","Ridge Cut Slough", 38.793302, -121.725666,
  "KNL","Knights Landing", 38.803300, -121.716413,
  "CCY","Cache Creek",  38.726596, -121.807117,
  "PTC","Putah Creek", 38.492433, -122.006321,
  "LIS","Lisbon Weir", 38.474753, -121.588603,
  "YBT","Tule Pond",	38.75058, -121.63525,
  "I80","Toe Drain at I80", 38.578201, -121.583643,
  "YBY","Tule Canal at RD22",	 38.677371, -121.644188
)

map_dat <- latest_stage %>%
  right_join(
    stations,
    by = "station"
  )

```

Hydrologic Conditions
=====================================
  
Column {data-width=40}
-------------------------------------
  
### Monitoring Stations
  
```{r}

leaflet(map_dat) |>
  
  addProviderTiles("Esri.WorldImagery") |>
  
  addCircleMarkers(lng = ~lon,lat = ~lat,
                   radius = 8,
                   fillOpacity = 0.9,
                   
                   popup = ~paste0(
                     "<b>",
                     label,
                     "</b><br>",
                     "Stage: ",
                     round(value,1),
                     " ft"
                   ))

```

Column {data-width=60}
-------------------------------------
### Flow Conditions

```{r fig.height=4}

##Plot setup
stage_plot <- stage_dat %>%
  filter(station %in% c("FRE", "YBT", "I80", "KNL", "RCS", "LIS"))

fcst_dat_sub <- fcst_dat[fcst_dat$station %in% c("FRE", "LIS"),]
forecast_label <- data.frame(
  datetime = min(fcst_dat_sub$datetime, na.rm = T) + lubridate::hours(48),
  stage = 35,
  label = "Forecast"
)

plot_labels <- data.frame(station = c(NA, "FRE", NA, "LIS"),
                          labels = c("forecast", "Weir tops", "LEBLS wet", "LIS flood"),
                          datetime = c(min(fcst_dat_sub$datetime, na.rm = T) + lubridate::hours(48),
                                       min(stage_plot$datetime) + lubridate::hours(48),
                                       min(stage_plot$datetime) + lubridate::hours(48),
                                       min(stage_plot$datetime) + lubridate::hours(48)),
                          stage = c(35, 33, 10, 14))

plot_labels$stationfac <- factor(plot_labels$station, levels = c("FRE", "LIS"),
                                labels = c("Fremont Weir", "Lisbon"))

xlims <- range(c(stage_plot$datetime, fcst_dat_sub$datetime), na.rm = TRUE)

station_cols <- c(
  "Fremont Weir" = "#1b9e77",  # Fremont Weir
  "Ridgecut" = "#d95f02",  # Ridge Cut
  "Sac R. at KNL" = "#7570b3",  # Knights Landing
  "Cache Creek" = "#e7298a",  # Cache Creek
  "Putah Creek" = "#66a61e",  # Putah Creek
  "Tule C. at RD22" = "#e6ab02",  # Tule Canal
  "Tule Pond" = "#a6761d",  # Tule Pond
  "I80" = "#666666",  # Toe Drain I80
  "Lisbon" = "brown"     # Toe Drain at Lisbon Weir
)

flow_dat$stationfac <- factor(flow_dat$station, 
                                levels = c("KNL", "RCS", "FRE", "CCY", "I80", "YBY", "PTC"),
                                labels = c("Sac R. at KNL", "Ridgecut", "Fremont Weir", "Cache Creek", 
                                           "I80", "Tule C. at RD22", "Putah Creek"))

plotly::ggplotly(ggplot(
  flow_dat[flow_dat$station %in% c("FRE", "RCS", "CCY", "PTC", "YBY"),], 
  aes(datetime, value, color = stationfac)) +
    geom_line(alpha = .7, linewidth = .8, alpha = .8) +
    theme_bw() +
    scale_color_manual(values = station_cols) +
    scale_x_datetime(limits = xlims) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Flow", color = NULL))

``` 
### Stage Conditions
  
```{r fig.height=4}

stage_plot$stationfac <- factor(stage_plot$station, 
                                levels = c("KNL", "RCS", "FRE", "YBT", "I80", "LIS"),
                                labels = c("Sac R. at KNL", "Ridgecut", "Fremont Weir", "Tule Pond", "I80", "Lisbon"))

fcst_dat_sub$stationfac <- factor(fcst_dat_sub$station, 
                                levels = c("FRE", "LIS"),
                                labels = c("Fremont Weir", "Lisbon"))

plotly::ggplotly(ggplot() + geom_rect(aes(xmin = min(fcst_dat_sub$datetime, na.rm = T), xmax = max(fcst_dat_sub$datetime, na.rm = T),
                                          ymin = 3, ymax = 36), fill = "grey80", alpha = 0.4, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
                   
                   geom_text(data = plot_labels, aes(datetime, stage, label = labels, color = stationfac),
                             hjust = 0, vjust = 0,fontface = "bold", show.legend = F)+
                   geom_line(data = stage_plot, aes(datetime, value, color = stationfac), 
                             linewidth = .8, alpha = .8) +
                   geom_line(data = fcst_dat_sub, aes(datetime, value, color = stationfac), 
                             linetype = 3, linewidth = .8, alpha = .8) +
                   geom_hline(yintercept = 32, linetype = 2, alpha = .5, linewidth = .5, color = "#1b9e77") +
                   geom_hline(yintercept = 9, linetype = 2, alpha = .5, linewidth = .5) +
                    geom_hline(yintercept = 13, linetype = 2, alpha = .5, linewidth = .5, color = "brown") +
                   scale_color_manual(values = station_cols) +
                   labs(x = NULL, y = "Stage (ft)", color = NULL) +
                   scale_x_datetime(limits = xlims) +
                   theme_bw())

```


Water Quality
=====================================

Column
-------------------------------------

### Dissolved Oxygen

```{r}

plotly::ggplotly(ggplot(
  do_dat[is.na(do_dat$value) == F, ],
  aes(datetime,value, color = station)) +
    geom_line() +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 6, color = "darkgreen",linetype = 2) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 4, color = "red", linetype = 2) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(title = "Dissolved Oxygen", y = "DO (mg/L)", 
         x = NULL,color = NULL))

```

### Specific Conductivity

```{r}

plotly::ggplotly(ggplot(
  cond_dat[is.na(cond_dat$value) == F, ], 
  aes(datetime, value, color = station)) +
    geom_line() +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(title = "Specific Conductivity", y = "Specific Conductivity",
         x = NULL, color = NULL
    ))
```

### Water Temperature

```{r}
temp_dat$temp_c <- round((temp_dat$value - 32) * 5 / 9, 1)
temp_dat$temp_c <- ifelse(temp_dat$temp_c < 2, NA,temp_dat$temp_c)
plotly::ggplotly(ggplot(
  temp_dat[is.na(temp_dat$value) == F, ],
  aes(datetime, temp_c, color = station)) +
    geom_line() +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 25, color = "red", linetype = 2) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(title = "Water Temperature", y = "Temperature (°C)",
         x = NULL,color = NULL))

```
